_comment: MiniMax provider config for the Review agent (pi).
The Jenkinsfile injects MINIMAX_API_KEY (from the Jenkins credential
'minimax-auth-token') and MINIMAX_BASE_URL at runtime, then invokes pi
This file defines the custom provider entry that maps those env vars to
pi's provider system. MiniMax speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so the
api type is 'anthropic'. Verify the exact schema against pi's
packages/coding-agent/docs/custom-provider.md and adjust field names if needed.
The API key is NEVER hardcoded here — it comes from $MINIMAX_API_KEY.
